text:
Sam C. (CSM): FYI AstraNova reached out: they want to onboard a custom multilingual legal summarizer. Data will include PHI + card-present payment snippets. They specifically requested private VPC + customer HSM. Can we take this?
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Thanks Sam. Quick: do they require Dedicated GPUs or just Private control plane? Any latency SLOs?
Sam C. (CSM): They prefer private VPC, will consider Dedicated if perf needed. Asked for p95 < 400ms on 512-token summaries. Prefers 13B class but open to tradeoffs. Also wants annual compliance audit paperwork.
Rahul P. (Safety): Safety spike: PHI + PCI triggers full safety lifecycle. Need: 1) redacted/synthetic eval set (500 examples min), 2) explicit failure-mode doc, 3) red-team prompt list, 4) acceptance criteria. No raw PHI in transit to hosted infra.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): OK I'll open intake. Requesting eval set in EN/ES/FR (they said those three langs). Also need taxonomy for summary labels (e.g., legal_issue, pii_present, redact_required).
Liang W. (Runtime Eng): Notes from runtime: 13B on Private is supported. If they want 4-bit quant + HSM-wrapped keys we may need a short compatibility spike (kernel paths). HSM for keywrap is fine; HSM for active inference crypto is more complex. Latency target tight depending on instance class and batching.
Sam C. (CSM): I'll ask customer to provide redacted examples, their failure definitions, and clarify VPC vs on-prem package. They offered to run an on-prem test with a very small raw-PHI set behind their firewall.
onboard-bot: Intake created — CS-8271 — AstraNova: "multilang-legal-summarizer" — owner: Anya M. — status: pending-safety-review
Rahul P. (Safety): Timeline: once eval set + prompts land, safety needs ~10 business days for initial eval and red-team. Please include acceptance criteria in ticket. We'll run PHI leakage scan + targeted red-team tests.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Draft acceptance criteria I'm adding to CS-8271: 
- ROUGE/ROUGE-L thresholds per language
- Factuality: <2% hallucination rate on targeted checks
- PHI leakage: zero regex/PII-model-detected leaks in test set
- Latency: p95 < 400ms (512 tokens) on agreed instance
- Operational: HSM keywrap verified, KMS policy docs provided
Also adding example request payload to make onboarding clearer:
```
model_request:
  name: astranova-legal-summarizer-v1
  family: custom-13b
  languages: [en, es, fr]
  data_classification: [PHI, PCI]
  deployment: private-vpc
  kms: customer-hsm
  eval_set_count: 500
  latency_target: p95 < 400ms @512t
```
Sam C. (CSM): Customer confirmed they can supply 500 redacted samples + 100 synthetic with injected edge cases. They'll also share a short runbook of critical failure modes. I'll upload to CS-8271 by EOD tomorrow.
Liang W. (Runtime Eng): If they insist on 4-bit quant + disk encryption + HSM keywrap, please mark as engineering spike. Could add ~1-2 weeks to timeline. Otherwise standard private deploy path looks fine.
Rahul P. (Safety): Also request list of prompts they consider sensitive (e.g., contract clauses that may contain PHI) so we can craft red-team scenarios.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with AstraNova next week after artifacts are attached.
Sam C. (CSM): Great. Adding: customer asked about an SLA for uptime and audit logs — I'll confirm which audit retention they need.
Anya M. (Solutions Eng): Leaving thread open for any blockers. Tagging CS-8271 watchers. :thumbsup:
